change_summary: Added Start-HibikiPreview-FormalWinUI.cmd next to the existing double-click wrappers: checks for pwsh, then runs tools/run-preview.ps1 -Build -Ui FormalWinUI -SmokeTest with the same Bypass/pause conventions.
Gives Windows users a one-click entry to the formal XAML shell that Issues #191/#348/#358 made buildable and launchable; requires Windows App Runtime 1.7 x64 (run-preview fails closed otherwise).
limitations: Launcher entry only; no driver, signing, installer or release claims.
README/AI_HANDOFF mention of this wrapper is tracked for the integrator snapshot refresh in Issue #367.
